feat(devices): unify business resource lifecycle to active/disabled/archived (#145)

* feat(devices): unify business resource lifecycle to active/disabled/archived

Remove draft/published as visibility states for device products, versions,
materials, fonts, and icon groups so create is immediately active and
admin enable/disable/archive replaces publish.

* fix(ci): clear staticcheck failures that block quality

Remove unused device-catalog and banner API leftovers and replace
deprecated zip header SetModTime so Mercury check can pass.

* fix(ci): format generated platform API client with Prettier

Lyra format-check rejects the OpenAPI TypeScript output until Prettier
rewrites it.

* fix(vega): keep required markers out of accessible field names

Required asterisks were part of label text, so tests and getByLabelText
could not match the visible field name.

* fix(vega): wait for resource upload form before oversized-file checks

The oversized-file case was racing an empty page and asserting a unique
alert plus a disabled submit button that the form does not set.

* fix(devices): serialize material product IDs as snowflake strings

Restore TransformSchema so OpenAPI exposes productId as a string, matching the rest of the catalog.

* fix(ci): prune stale runtime client models after generate-check

Point Orion at the generated Dart client that matches the live runtime spec.

* fix(ci): run SQL migrations against the Actions Postgres service

Docker Compose migrate needs a local .env and image that CI does not provide.

* fix(ci): pause SQL migrations until platform owner bootstrap

00059 grants icon permissions to platform_owner, which migrate cannot
create. Apply through 58 first, then resume after bootstrap in CI
test-db and E2E.

* fix(ci): put bootstrap password inside the test-db subshell

The previous assignment before `(cd ...)` is invalid bash and aborted
PostgreSQL integration tests before they started.

* fix(ci): bootstrap platform owner before isolated E2E migrations

Protected-value Postgres tests create empty databases and called
migration.Run, which cannot apply 00059 until platform_owner exists.

* fix(devices): preserve version CAS revision when forking

Forked versions started at revision 1, so a stale UpdateVersion with
revision 1 succeeded. Carry the previous revision forward, and align
integration fixtures with BCP47 regions and active font status.

* fix(devices): cast disabled_by and finish schema-75 fixtures

PostgreSQL inferred CASE disabled_by as text, so Disable failed.
Integration tests now rewind goose without version gaps, seed BCP47
regions, and keep font/storage mutations valid after draft removal.
